variables.input:
timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime), by: { cluster_name }
| fields cluster_name

timeseries avg(aerospike_namespace_objects, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }), by: { ns }
| fields ns

timeseries avg(aerospike_sindex_entries, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and ns == $namespace }), by: { sindex }
| fields sindex

0.content: **Secondary Index View**: One secondary index in detail: entries, memory, garbage collection, load time. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

3.title: Memory Used
3.query:
timeseries value = avg(aerospike_sindex_memory_used, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and ns == $namespace and sindex == $sindex })
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
3.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
avg(aerospike_sindex_memory_used{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", sindex=~"$sindex"})
or 
avg(aerospike_sindex_used_bytes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", sindex=~"$sindex"})

4.title: Entries/Bins
4.query:
timeseries value = sum(aerospike_sindex_entries_per_bval, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and ns == $namespace and sindex == $sindex }, rollup: avg)
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
4.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(aerospike_sindex_entries_per_bval{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", sindex=~"$sindex"})

5.title: Garbage collection
5.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(increase(aerospike_sindex_stat_gc_recs{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", sindex=~"$sindex"}[5m]))

6.title: Load percentage
6.query:
timeseries value = min(aerospike_sindex_load_pct, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and ns == $namespace and sindex == $sindex })
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
6.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
min(aerospike_sindex_load_pct{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", sindex=~"$sindex"})

7.title: Max Load Time
7.query:
timeseries value = max(aerospike_sindex_load_time, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and ns == $namespace and sindex == $sindex })
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
7.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
max(aerospike_sindex_load_time{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", sindex=~"$sindex"})

8.title: Entries
8.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_sindex_entries, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and ns == $namespace and sindex == $sindex }, rollup: avg), a1 = max(aerospike_namespace_effective_replication_factor, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and ns == $namespace })
| fieldsAdd value = (a0[] / a1[])
| fieldsRemove a0, a1
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
8.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(aerospike_sindex_entries{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", sindex=~"$sindex"}) / max(aerospike_namespace_effective_replication_factor{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})

9.title: Entries/Records
9.query:
timeseries value = sum(aerospike_sindex_entries_per_rec, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and ns == $namespace and sindex == $sindex }, rollup: avg)
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
9.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(aerospike_sindex_entries_per_rec{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", sindex=~"$sindex"})
